foot noun

also feet, paw, paws

classical

Traupman 58
Traupman 317

pēs, pedis m.

noun, third declension

The ablative is pede, with short e.

Examples

  • Pedēs lavēmus.

    Let’s wash our feet.composed

See also hop on one foot, jump, knee, hand, toe, heel, sole, ankle.
